name: Trust / Conversion Architecture
purpose: Connect company-specific creative form to a trustworthy, psychologically safe next action without evidence bloat.

rules.when: A verified company fact is present but not adjacent to a service action.
rules.do: Place the fact beside one company-specific sentence describing what happens during the consultation.
rules.limit: One or two verified facts; do not add a metric merely to decorate the CTA.

rules.when: The customer's hesitation is part of the problem.
rules.do: State before the CTA that the customer may consult before deciding, using only a verified company policy or service truth.
rules.limit: Permission must not imply a no-pressure policy unless the client has confirmed it.

rules.when: The action is a consultation, inquiry or application.
rules.do: Design a CTA Zone with Before CTA reason, the action itself, and After CTA expectation or decision boundary.
rules.limit: Unknown post-click details become an evidence slot, never invented copy.

rules.when: Trust improvement suggests adding cards, FAQs or many proof points.
rules.do: Prefer one connected proof sequence over quantity.
rules.limit: Keep Strong Screen + Quiet Chapter and Screenshot Peak Budget at 2-4 screens.

rules.when: Trust copy is added to a desktop-first composition.
rules.do: Re-art the mobile CTA Zone and preserve a visible action at 390x844.
rules.limit: Run widths 320, 360, 375, 390, 430, 768, 1024, 1280 and 1440; no horizontal overflow or forbidden Japanese line shapes.

rules.when: Verified owner or service evidence is present and the visitor still has to infer what happens next.
rules.do: Connect one identity fact to one operational action and one decision boundary in the CTA Zone.
rules.limit: Use only facts verified for this company; do not imply a named person is assigned unless confirmed.

rules.when: Trust research exposes an absent policy, response time, confidentiality promise or guarantee.
rules.do: Record UNKNOWN and reserve an evidence slot for future hearing.
rules.limit: Never convert an UNKNOWN into reassuring marketing copy.

rules.when: Selecting which company facts to place in a Sales Sample.
rules.do: Score evidence from E1 Weak through E5 Decision Enabling and prefer the smallest connected sequence.
rules.limit: Strength describes decision usefulness, not the amount of copy or prestige of the claim.

ablation_validation.design: Three states per prototype: unchanged Formal PASS baseline, Trust Core, and unchanged Full Enriched. Core uses one company fact, one operational path, and one decision/risk boundary.

findings.P02: Trust Core improved Trust/Conversion directionally over Baseline, while Full Enriched remained stronger on Trust. The process plus decision boundary appears useful; 20年/300社 alone is not isolated as the cause.
findings.P10: Trust Core was equivalent to the existing minimum CTA evidence, while Full Enriched improved over Core. Named accountable-person and continuity/business-model evidence appear complementary; person-only causality is not isolated.
findings.evidence_economy: Not validated as Core equals Full. Use precision and sequence, but retain additional verified evidence when it resolves a distinct objection.
findings.causal_limit: Structured role comparisons are directional research evidence, not a statistical experiment or real-world conversion measurement.

rule_cards.when: The page has a verified company fact but the visitor must infer how service delivery works or when to decide.
require: one verified decision or risk boundary
rule_cards.do: Connect WHO, HOW and NEXT in one short proof-to-action sequence.
rule_cards.place: Middle to Before CTA, with the decision boundary in the CTA Zone.
rule_cards.limit: Do not treat a metric, name or credential as sufficient trust by itself.
rule_cards.fallback: If any required fact is UNKNOWN, keep the slot labeled HEARING_REQUIRED and do not generate reassurance.

rule_cards.when: A verified fact is selected for Trust or Conversion.
rule_cards.do: Place E2 identity near the service explanation, E3 process before the action, and E4/E5 boundary or expectation immediately around the CTA.
rule_cards.place: Hero only when it changes immediate understanding; otherwise Middle or CTA Zone.
rule_cards.limit: Do not create a proof-card wall or move every evidence item into the Hero.
rule_cards.fallback: When placement intent is unclear, keep the evidence in a quiet chapter and route the missing placement decision to review.

rule_cards.when: A trust-relevant policy, response expectation, scope, fee condition or accountability fact cannot be verified.
rule_cards.do: Block reassuring copy and preserve an evidence slot for hearing.
rule_cards.place: Internal evidence ledger and production handoff; never as invented customer-facing proof.
rule_cards.limit: Never infer no-pressure, confidentiality, guarantee, response time or assigned-person claims.
rule_cards.fallback: Use neutral copy that does not promise the unknown and mark HEARING_REQUIRED.

provenance: Derived from the 2026-09-15 P02/P09/P10 formal blind tournament and official external-page research. Structured Work review, not independent human-third-party evidence.

evidence_strength_model.definition: 一般的説明で、会社固有性がない。
evidence_strength_model.placement: 原則LPのTrust proofには使わない。

evidence_strength_model.definition: 会社固有の氏名、資格、経歴、実績、対応範囲。
evidence_strength_model.placement: 入口付近またはQuiet Chapterで1点。

evidence_strength_model.definition: 誰が何をするかが分かる実務・プロセス情報。
顧客の不利益や心理的不安を直接減らす確認済み情報。
evidence_strength_model.placement: CTA直前のPermission／境界として使う。

evidence_strength_model.definition: 次に進むか、どの条件で進むかを判断できる情報。

REQUIRED: 誰が対応するか（担当者または担当チーム）
最初の相談／問い合わせ後に何が起きるか
料金・無料条件と費用発生タイミング
公開可能な一次EvidenceのURLまたは確認方法
HIGH_VALUE: 相談方法・時間・場所
無理な勧誘をしない場合の明示方針
契約・転職を進めない場合の扱い
顧客が選べること・断れること
代表者の言葉・実在事例
OPTIONAL: 権利許諾済みの人物写真

validation_note: P02/P10のBaseline／Trust Core／Full Enrichedを同一Capture系統で比較したStructured Work Review。P02はCoreでTrust/Conversionの方向改善、P10はCoreがBaseline同等でFullの追加Evidenceに改善が残った。したがってTrust RuleはREPLICATEDまたはENGINE_READYへ一括昇格しない。
engine_ready_candidate_note: 今回の6条件を満たすTrust Ruleはなし。UNKNOWN_BOUNDARYとMOBILE_ACTION_BUDGETは実装安全策として再利用しやすいが、Trust因果のENGINE_READY_CANDIDATEにはまだ昇格しない。
